name: ORSEE - BEER Lab Tec de Monterrey
description: ORSEE 3.4.0 subject-pool recruitment & session scheduling for the Behavioral & Experimental Economics Research Lab (BEER Lab), Tecnologico de Monterrey.

ORSEE_SERVER_PROTOCOL.description: Public protocol. Leave as https:// on Heroku (TLS terminates at the router).

ORSEE_SERVER_URL.description: Public host with NO protocol and NO trailing slash, e.g. myapp.herokuapp.com or lab.tec.mx. If left blank ORSEE falls back to the incoming Host header.

ORSEE_ROOT_DIRECTORY.description: URL sub-path where ORSEE is mounted. Keep empty: the web root already points at orsee/.

ORSEE_MAIL_TRANSPORT.description: Use 'phpmailer' on Heroku (dynos have no local MTA). 'mail' only works where PHP mail() is wired to an MTA.

ORSEE_SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP relay host for outgoing email (e.g. smtp.sendgrid.net, or your Tec relay).

ORSEE_SMTP_SECURE.description: SMTP encryption: tls, ssl, or empty.

ORSEE_SMTP_USER.description: SMTP username (for SendGrid this is literally 'apikey').

ORSEE_SMTP_PASS.description: SMTP password / API key. Set as a config var; never commit it.
